verdict.rationale: Angular Elements (angular-gh-8) allow embedding individual Angular components as custom elements into any page, and the AngularJS-to-Angular upgrade guide (angular-gh-3) supports incremental migration of existing apps, both pointing toward incremental adoption. However there's no first-party guidance framed explicitly as 'start small, scale to full app' the way some competing frameworks document, and no independent/community evidence confirming this workflow in practice. missing for 10: dedicated incremental-adoption documentation/tutorial, hands-on community reports of embedding Angular into an existing non-Angular page successfully.
